name: usage-limit
description: Guards the account usage limit: one subagent at a time above 90%, a pause with a reserve at 98%, and an automatic resume when the window resets

reserve.title: Reserve
reserve.description: Final percentage of the limit kept for the user. The session pauses at 100 minus this value

alert.title: Alert
alert.description: Above this percentage, only one subagent runs at a time

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: Time zone for the times shown in messages

resumeOnError.title: Resume on limit error
resumeOnError.description: Also resumes a session that hit 100% with the limit error, at the time the window resets

bandFrom.title: Band from
bandFrom.description: Show the usage band above the prompt from this percentage
